configuration.template:
id: ninfa-contract
info:
  name: Ninfa controlled contract marker
  author: ninfa
  severity: info
http:
  - method: GET
    path:
      - "{{BaseURL}}/"
    matchers:
      - type: word
        name: contract-marker
        words:
          - NINFA_CONTRACT_MARKER

limits: controlled fixture; positive output contract, not production coverage
